title: 3.2.B5 Build-Up — Sun Rotates
description: Add a slow Y-axis rotation to the sun so it spins in place while the planets orbit around it.

steps.title: Spin the sun on Y
steps.instructions: In draw(), add `sun.rotation.y += 0.005` so the sun slowly rotates on its axis.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the rotation property section.
